analogue: Glyoxal vapor reacts during uptake onto deliquesced aqueous ammonium sulfate particles, including formation of nitrogen-containing condensed products.
citation: Online Speciation of Glyoxal Multiphase Reactions on Deliquesced Ammonium Sulfate Particles
evidence: Simultaneous gas- and particle-phase chemical speciation tracked glyoxal uptake and chemical transformation on sulfate seed at relative humidity at or above about 80%.
difference: The experiment supplied glyoxal directly rather than identifying the o-cresol-derived V_C mixture. Liquid water, reversibility, and the yield of persistent material near 50% RH are unresolved.
